patch_description: Retain useful geometry even when the first SLSQP call reaches its iteration limit, because its returned iterate can still have a better exact diameter ratio. Then rescale that iterate to an explicitly feasible diameter-one formulation and run a second, longer exact constrained solve. This implements an active-set tightening pass: the first solve discovers a contact graph, while the second starts with strict lower-bound slack near that graph and can move all contacts jointly without being limited by the original nearly-active initialization.
